default/30671.htm.text: Chief Croto: Our tribe is being treated like dogs to Dwarves after being ousted from the village by betrayers. But we are not dogs... We are wolves! One day we will get back the temple and paint the hills with the blood of betrayers.

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30671-01.html.text: Chief Croto: This old fool just doesn't understand... The Contract was over last month! You don't know how that Dwarf feels about Orcs? Oh, damn... Oh, well, believe what you will. Now leave, I am busy!

links.text: Tell him that you will do whatever it takes.

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30671-03.html.text: Chief Croto: The altar of our ancestors is in the Cave of Trial. It is a huge cave in an area frequented by Orcs. Our army was last seen heading there. My nephew was among them. If you search the cave, you may find the remains of my nephew. If he was killed by monsters, please bring his belongings …

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30671-04.html.text: Chief Croto: I see. My nephew died a hero's death. I am jealous in a way... He was so tragically young. His name will be inscribed forever in Pa'agrio's temple. Now only bitter sorrow is left for this old man... I must send reinforcements to Elder Balanki. Well done!

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30671-05.html.text: Chief Croto: Thank you for letting me know of my nephew's fate! I have sent more soldiers to Elder Balanki. You may now leave safely!
